en.headline: Police to hold highest honour funeral for senior officer Zhu Chun-kwok
en.dek: The force will conduct the ceremony on Friday for the officer who was stabbed while on duty in 2005 and died in September after 21 years.
body: The Hong Kong Police Force will hold a highest honour funeral on Friday for Senior Police Constable Zhu Chun-kwok, who died in September after spending 21 years in a vegetative state.

Zhu was stabbed in the neck in 2005 while on duty in Cheung Sha Wan. He pursued the attacker despite his injuries and suffered severe blood loss that left him paralysed. He died of organ failure on 16 September at the age of 52.

The ceremony will begin at 10:30 am at the Universal Funeral Parlour in Hung Hom. A farewell will follow at Cheung Sha Wan Police Station, and the burial at Gallant Garden in Fanling is scheduled for around 12:30 pm on Friday. The force said the highest honour is reserved for officers killed in the line of duty or who died after heroic action.
Police expressed deep sorrow and said they would provide all appropriate assistance to the family.

zh.headline: 警務處周五為朱振國舉行最高榮譽喪禮
zh.dek: 2005年執勤遭割頸後臥床21年的高級警員朱振國9月離世，警隊周五於紅磡世界殯儀館舉行最高規格喪禮，其後安葬浩園。
body: 警務處宣布周五為已故高級警員朱振國舉行警隊最高榮譽喪禮。朱振國2005年在長沙灣執勤時遭人持刀割頸，負傷追捕後因失血過多全身癱瘓成植物人，臥床21年後於今年9月16日因器官衰竭離世，終年52歲。
喪禮明早10時半在紅磡世界殯儀館舉行，其後在長沙灣分區警署進行道別儀式，安葬儀式下午約12時半在粉嶺浩園舉行。
警隊最高榮譽喪禮是為在執行任務時被殺害或奮不顧身行動英勇殉職的人員而設。警務處向其家人致以深切慰問，並表示會提供一切適切協助。
朱振國獲頒金英勇勳章，其家人一直希望能以最高規格安葬。
